entries.content:
# Source: Mac Sai (formerly MacClean), integrator pointers

Repo https://github.com/iliyami/MacSai @2c9ec77 (2026-09-22). BSD-3-Clause, so code can be copied if the notice is kept. Swift 6 SwiftPM, macOS 14+.
- Clone: research/sources/iliyami-macsai
- Report: research/reports/sources/iliyami-macsai.md (task T-0016)
- Findings filed: F-0026 (deselect is overridden by the parent folder), F-0027 (iOS backups, Archives and Simulator Devices pre-checked), F-0028 (packages sized 0 B in the disk map)
- Evidence added to F-0024 (blocklist guard) via T-0014, and to F-0011 and F-0012 via T-0013

## Where things live (paths relative to the clone)
- Deletion entry point: `Sources/MacClean/CleanActions.swift` `executeUserClean` (category routing :46-57, then `prunedToParents` :180-204).
- Engine: `Sources/MacClean/Core/Cleaner/CleaningEngine.swift` `clean` (5k chunks, 500k cap, per-chunk `Progress`, benign ENOENT :272-282). Per-item log at `~/Library/Logs/MacClean/operations.log` (:301-323).
- Gate: `Sources/MacCleanKit/SafetyGuard.swift` `validatePath` (:68-117) and `canonicalizeMacOSFirmlinks` (:135-146). Protected list: `Constants.swift:56-94`. Do not copy the policy (blocklist); copy the firmlink canonicalizer.
- Scan-time actionability: `Sources/MacCleanKit/CleanFilter.swift` (parent W_OK + dir W_OK + excluded folders).
- Rules: `Sources/MacCleanKit/Categories/*.swift` return `[ScanTarget]` (`ScanTarget.swift:5-42`: path/recursive/maxDepth/ext/minAge/maxAge/minSize/excludes/skipHidden). Paths: `Constants.swift:96-187`. Pre-select table: `Models/ScanCategory.swift:147-170` (per category).
- Scanner: `Sources/MacClean/Core/Scanner/TargetedScanner.swift` (TaskGroup per target, the `open(O_DIRECTORY)` TCC-denial probe at :61-65, lstat inode at :195-215).
- Orphans: `Sources/MacCleanKit/OrphanedAppFiles.swift` `isOrphan` (reverse-DNS with 3 or more parts, never-flag prefixes, dotted lineage, helper-suffix strip). Driver: `Sources/MacClean/Modules/SystemJunk/AppLeftoversScanner.swift` (only Caches, Logs, HTTPStorages, Saved Application State, WebKit).
- Uninstaller: `Sources/MacCleanKit/AppMatching.swift` (substring patterns, 17 Library subdirs), `Modules/Uninstaller/UninstallerModule.swift` (`AppDiscovery.appBundles` depth 4, `AppPathFinder`). Protected apps are checked by bundle id in `Views/Applications/AppUninstaller.swift`.
- Duplicates: `Sources/MacCleanKit/DuplicateDetection.swift` (size, then partial hash, then full hash, then inode dedupe). `FileConsolidator.swift:95-143` does clonefile, verifies the hash, then an atomic rename.
- Thinning: `Sources/MacCleanKit/Cleaner/ThinAppBundleOperation.swift` (backup, then `codesign --verify --deep` before and after, rollback on failure).
- Disk map: `Sources/MacClean/Core/Scanner/FileTreeScanner.swift` + `Views/Files/SpaceLensView.swift` + `Sources/MacCleanKit/SquarifiedTreemap.swift` (one-level squarified layout, tested).
- Big lists: `Views/Shared/FileTableView.swift` (NSTableView, because SwiftUI List beachballs at tens of thousands of rows), `Sources/MacCleanKit/FileListRows.swift`.
- Admin tasks: `Modules/Maintenance/PrivilegedShellRunner.swift` (in-process NSAppleScript, so the admin prompt is cached for 5 minutes), `Sources/MacCleanKit/MaintenanceShell.swift` (quoting).

## Gotchas
- README vs code: the XPC root helper was removed in #71 (61fe8f9). The GRDB `AppDatabase` is used only by tests. `FSEventMonitor` has no live caller. Do not cite the README Architecture or Tech stack sections as fact.
- `SafetyGuard` passes `/`, `~`, `~/Documents`, `/Applications` and Keychains. Its symlink check compares only the first 3 path components. Verified with the unmodified file in scratchpad/dive-iliyami-macsai/harness.
- Directories are sized 0 wherever `totalFileAllocatedSize` is read. Every consumer re-walks the tree for folder sizes. `.skipsPackageDescendants` gives `.app` bundles 0 B in Space Lens.
- `LanguageFilesCategory` scans `/Applications` with skipsPackageDescendants, so it never finds in-bundle `.lproj`. It is effectively dead, which is good.
- `prunedToParents` claims O(n log n), but `contains` inside the loop makes it O(n·k).
- To compile MacCleanKit files standalone you need `SharedAppState.swift` and `LanguagePreferences.swift` along with `Localization.swift`. `main.swift` must not use `-parse-as-library`.

entries.name: Bench: scan engines
entries.content:
Owner: bench-harness (T-0004). Report: research/reports/bench-scan-engines.md. Raw data: research/bench/results/.

## How to rerun

```
cd ~/projects/macontrol/research/bench
./make_fixture.sh               # ~35 s the first time, then a no-op; FORCE=1 rebuilds
./run.sh fixture                # or: real | both (default)
RUNS=10 WARMUP=2 REPEAT=5 REAL_TREE=~/Library ./run.sh real
```
- make_fixture.sh builds fixtures/tree (300,000 file entries, 10,505 dirs, 1,032 symlinks, ~1.7 GB physical, 7.3 GB apparent). It writes fixtures/ground_truth.json and copies it to results/. Seeded RNG, so the sizes and names are the same every run.
- run.sh: for every scanner on PATH it does REPEAT untimed runs (the first under `/usr/bin/time -l`, for exit code, max RSS and peak footprint; every run's total is kept to detect nondeterminism), then one apparent-size run, then a hyperfine pass (`-N -i`, warm cache). Output: results/<target>-hyperfine.json, results/<target>-summary.json, and a markdown table on stdout.
- To add a scanner (for example a macontrol engine prototype), add one line to TOOLS in run.sh: `name|disk-usage cmd {}|apparent cmd {}`. The total is parsed as the largest line-leading integer in the output.

## Gotchas
- **Warm cache is not warm here.** `kern.maxvnodes` = 120,350 on this 8 GB M1, but the fixture has about 311k inodes and ~/projects about 469k entries. Single-threaded walkers (du, ncdu) spend most of their wall time off-CPU even on repeat runs. Parallel walkers hide that latency, which is where most of their lead comes from.
- **Cold cache was not measured.** It needs `sudo purge`. Run it by hand as `sudo purge; ./run.sh` with WARMUP=0 RUNS=1, and repeat.
- The fixture lives inside ~/projects. run.sh does `chmod 000 research/bench/fixtures` during the real-tree pass and a trap restores it. If the run is SIGKILLed, run `chmod 755 research/bench/fixtures`.
- Other agents write into ~/projects during the run (research/sources clones), so real-tree totals drift between tools. Compare tools within one pass, not across passes.
- The load average was 15-18 during the recorded run because other agents were running. Treat absolute seconds as noisy and ratios as more reliable.
- Never edit run.sh while it is running. bash reads scripts incrementally.
- Homebrew installs gdu as `gdu-go`. dust `-d 0` printed nothing when the tree has a >PATH_MAX path, so the harness uses `-d 1`. pdu rejects `-d 0` and double-counts hard links unless given `-H`. `du -A -k` rounds every file up to 1 KiB (+57 MB on 300k files), and BSD `du -B 1` does not print bytes. ncdu has no total line, so run.sh parses its JSON export (`-o file`) and uses `-o /dev/null` for timing.
- To delete the fixture: `chmod -R u+rwx fixtures && rm -rf fixtures`. It contains a chmod-000 dir and a path longer than PATH_MAX, which BSD rm handles.

## Brew formulae installed for this (the user may remove them)
diskus, dua-cli, dust, gdu, hyperfine, ncdu, parallel-disk-usage, plus the dependency ncurses (only ncdu uses it; zstd was already installed).
To remove them: `brew uninstall diskus dua-cli dust gdu hyperfine ncdu parallel-disk-usage ncurses`

## Results (2026-09-23, warm, load avg 10-18)
- Fixture (300k files), wall time: dua 0.70 s, diskus 1.21, pdu 1.33, dust 1.38, ncdu-t8 1.47, gdu 1.73, du 5.88, bulkwalk (serial) 7.10, ncdu (1 thread) 8.27.
- ~/projects (469k entries): dua 1.88 s, then diskus, pdu, gdu, ncdu-t8 and dust at 2.5-3.1 s. du 12.6 s, ncdu 15.2 s.
- Exact ground truth: only ncdu and bulkwalk, both fd-relative. Everyone else drops `pathmax/` (F-0008). gdu is nondeterministic (F-0007). pdu counts hard links per link by default (F-0010). Serial walks are latency-bound (F-0009).
- PRIVATESIZE|CLONEID|EXT_FLAGS cost, serial: sys +61% on the fixture and +70% on ~/projects, wall +12% and +64%. The sum of private sizes is exact on the fixture (1,446,752,256).


--- 2026-09-23T10:14:07 · bench-harness ---
## Rerun the baseline walker
- research/bench/bulkwalk.c is the serial fd-relative getattrlistbulk baseline, and `-x` adds PRIVATESIZE|CLONEID|EXT_FLAGS. run.sh compiles it into research/bench/tools/ (gitignored).
- Subset runs: `ONLY='^bulkwalk' TAG=bulkwalk ./run.sh fixture` writes results/fixture-bulkwalk-*.json, so the full-run files stay intact.
- A FORCE=1 rebuild of the fixture reproduced every count and byte total in ground_truth.json exactly.

entries.name: Source: mac-cleanup-py
entries.content:
Durable pointers for integrating mac-cleanup-py (https://github.com/mac-cleanup/mac-cleanup-py). Apache-2.0, 2,374 stars. Pinned at ba4d6ef (2025-10-04), clone at research/sources/mac-cleanup-mac-cleanup-py. Full report: research/reports/sources/mac-cleanup-mac-cleanup-py.md ## Where things are - **All rules:** `mac_cleanup/default_modules.py` (43 functions, 102 `Path(...)` literals, 26 `Command(...)`). The rules are Python code, not data. A regex like `Path\(\s*((?:"[^"]*"\s*)+)\)(\.dry_run_only\(\))?` extracts them (28 deletable globs, 63 literal paths, 11 dry_run_only). - **Rule DSL:** `mac_cleanup/core_modules.py`. `Path` = `rm -rf '

'` (:124), `.dry_run_only()` (:134), `.with_prompt(msg)` (:23), `Command(str)` (:90). - **Collector and dry-run sizing:** `mac_cleanup/core.py` `_Collector._get_size` (:109-187), `_extract_paths` (:195-233). - **Guard:** `mac_cleanup/utils.py` `check_deletable` (:69-100), `check_exists` (:47-66), `cmd` (:9-29). - **Run loop and "Removed" figure:** `mac_cleanup/main.py` `cleanup` (:31-50), `start` (:52-102). - **Config and custom-module loader:** `mac_cleanup/config.py` (:204-247). - **Lineage:** the rule list comes from mac-cleanup-sh (MIT, Florian Wartner 2020), `mac-cleanup` script. Same literals: `folders/bh` :154, MobileSync :190, `*.hprof` :444, `sudo dscacheutil` :450. Credit both projects in NOTICE. ## Gotchas before copying rules - Glob rules never delete in the source: the path is single-quoted into `rm -rf`. Its dry-run numbers are not evidence that a rule works (F-0025, issue #279). - `/private/var/folders/bh/*/*/*/*` hardcodes one user's prefix. Use `confstr(_CS_DARWIN_USER_CACHE_DIR)` and never wipe `T/` or `0/` of live processes. - `[!Library|var|tmp|Media]*` (:99, :103) is a character class, not alternation. - `arc` deletes History, Cookies and Web Data (:505-516), although the README calls it "caches". iOS backups (:74) and Xcode Archives (:81) have no prompt. Put these in the user-data tier (F-0027). - `steam` deletes `steamapps/download` (:154), which holds in-progress downloads. - `docker` silently starts Docker Desktop (:285-299), and `telegram` runs `killall -KILL` (:443). - `inactive_memory` (`sudo purge`) and `dns_cache` are not disk cleanup. Leave them out or put them behind the helper (F-0029). - Good pattern to keep: the tool's own clean command plus `Path(cache).dry_run_only()` for sizing. That covers npm, pnpm, yarn, bun, pod, go, composer and conan (:132-139, :311-375). Run it through a ToolRunner with argv, a timeout and stdin=/dev/null. - Do not run its test suite on a real home: `tests/test_config.py:247-284` creates `~/Documents/my-custom-modules` and `~/Documents/mac-cleanup/`. ## Probe scratchpad `dive-mac-cleanup-mac-cleanup-py/probe.py`: imports the source's own `Path`, `_Collector` and `check_deletable` against a temp fixture (venv with rich, attrs, beartype, xattr, toml). Results: - glob: dry-run 1,052,864 B, 0 deleted - `/System/*` -> deletable - an apostrophe in a path injects shell - hard link + clone counted 3x

entries.name: Source: Kudu
entries.content:
Source: Kudu (AdventDevInc/kudu). MIT, 3 562 stars, Electron/TypeScript, Windows-first cross-platform cleaner.
- Clone: research/sources/adventdevinc-kudu @ 0ef4292 (v3.4.0, 2026-09-22).
- Report: research/reports/sources/adventdevinc-kudu.md
- Task: T-0018
- Findings: F-0030 (macOS uninstall fails open and deletes without review), F-0031 (walking '/' double-counts the Data volume and crosses mounts), F-0032 (rule paths are unconstrained).
- Probes: research/bench/adventdevinc-kudu/
  - probe.ts + matcher.ts + safelist.ts: leftover matcher, verbatim copy
  - firmlink_probe.ts + measure.ts: Kudu size fn through both firmlink routes
  - mountstatus_probe.c: ATTR_DIR_MOUNTSTATUS / dev / ino for firmlink paths
  - rule_schema_probe.py: Kudu schema accepts ${HOME}, '/', '..'
  - Run the .ts files with plain `node x.ts` (node 26 strips types).

## Rule data (reusable, MIT; keep the notice)
- rules/darwin/{apps,browsers,gaming,gpu-cache,system,databases,steam,misc}.json:
  - 74 app, 6 gaming, 22 system and 21 DB targets
  - 13 Chromium-family bases with profile/shared cache dir lists (browsers.json:4-37)
  - Firefox forks with profile + cache roots (browsers.json:38-48)
- Template vars on darwin: HOME, LIBRARY, CACHES, APP_SUPPORT, TMPDIR (src/main/rules/loader.ts:135-144; allowlist in src/main/rules/validate.ts:15-19).
- Schema: rules/schema/rules.schema.json, draft-07. The best shapes to copy:
  - AppCacheDef fields: minAgeDays, cacheReset, cleanupAction, group, description
  - RecursivePathMatch (anchor, anchorPaths with a '..'-rejecting pattern at :125-126, targets, excludedAncestors, maxDepth <= 32)
  - DirectFileMatch (names, childDirSuffix, minAgeDays, skipIfChildExists)
- Schema gap: TemplatePath has no pattern at all (:16-19). See F-0032.
- Fix before import:
  - unity path duplicated (apps.json:46 and gpu-cache.json:6)
  - "Android Studio" = all of Caches/Google (apps.json:44)
  - ~/.m2/repository is not rebuildable (apps.json:26)
  - whole Saved Application State (system.json:12)
  - /private/tmp (system.json:6)
  - ${HOME} placeholders guarded only by cleanupAction (apps.json:5,21)
- Contributor tooling: scripts/find-cache.js, preview-rule.js, parity-check.js, new-rule.js, generate-catalog.js; .github/workflows/rules-bot.yml (validates and summarises rule PRs).

## Engine ideas worth porting (Swift rewrite, not code copy)
- src/main/services/file-utils.ts
  - resolveChildren/resolveEntry :714-796: subtree recency. A dir is offered as one item only if every descendant is older than the cutoff. Depth 8, budget 250k. The doc comment is at :670-692 (issue #265: "dir mtime lies").
  - revalidateRecencyItem :799-818: the same check again just before rm.
  - cleanItemsNow :305-667: IDs only, expired IDs reported, exclusions, measure, revalidate, delete. Ancestor/descendant grouping :566-620, 8 workers. Partial-delete salvage deleteDirectoryBestEffort :90-129.
- src/main/services/scan-cache.ts: UUID -> ScanItem map. The clean IPC never takes paths.
- src/main/ipc/large-file-finder.ipc.ts:249-275: re-lstat and require the same dev, ino, size, mtimeNs and ctimeNs before trash/rm. refreshHardLinkChangeTimes :26-59.
- src/main/services/uninstall-leftovers.ts:118-146, 250-283: ownership proof. A leftover must have an owner that was previously seen installed (leftover-owners.json) and is now absent.
- src/main/services/cleanup-receipts.ts: per-run receipt. Its statfs delta runs on Windows only (:182-200).

## Gotchas (do not copy)
- Deletes are permanent: fs.rm recursive (file-utils.ts:230-281). The 'secure delete' overwrite (:159-228) means nothing on APFS SSDs.
- Sizes are logical everywhere (cleanup-measurement.ts:18). No blocks, hard links or clones.
- macOS gaps:
  - no FDA handling (grep finds nothing)
  - no cleaner elevation (ipc/index.ts:258-260; issue #443)
  - running-app blockers are Windows-only (services/cleaner-blockers.ts)
  - liveness on darwin = mtime > 60 min only. Sockets and locks in TMPDIR or /private/tmp are offered.
- Disk analyzer (ipc/disk-analyzer.ipc.ts):
  - serial walk, tree capped at depth 3
  - files are not nodes, and the treemap is one level of DOM divs with no tile click
  - the drive list is every /dev mount from df
  - '/' double-counts the Data volume (F-0031)
  - the store defaults selectedDrive to 'C' (renderer/src/stores/disk-store.ts:47)
- Uninstaller on darwin: see F-0030. system_profiler list plus the Windows pipeline. verifyUninstall fails open. Fuzzy leftovers are rm -rf'd without review.
- macOS facts verified with probes on 26.6:
  - / and /System/Volumes/Data report the SAME st_dev (16777229). Firmlinked dirs share dev+ino.
  - ATTR_DIR_MOUNTSTATUS/DIR_MNTSTATUS_MNTPOINT is set on /, /System/Volumes/Data, VM and Preboot, and not on /Users, /Volumes or /private/var.

entries.content:
Durable pointers for anyone integrating ideas from MangoDisk (harry0703/MangoDisk, GPL-3.0, so STUDY ONLY: no code, no TOML rules, no evidence text). Clone: research/sources/harry0703-mangodisk @ 19e55d2. Report: research/reports/sources/harry0703-mangodisk.md. Task T-0019.

Path prefixes: core = src-tauri/crates/mangodisk-core, platform = src-tauri/crates/mangodisk-platform.

RULES (the best rule model among the sources)
- Schema doc: core/rules/README.md (filesystem schema v3 :35-155, project artifacts v1 :157-206, Downloads exception :145-153).
- Rule files: core/rules/filesystem/macos/{system,browser,application,development,ai,container}/<id>.toml (120 for macOS), core/rules/project-artifacts/<eco>.toml (31).
- Build-time validation and embedding: core/build.rs:6-40, which #[path]-includes core/src/cleanup/rules/declarative_schema.rs and protected_paths.rs. Runtime catalogue: core/src/cleanup/rules/declarative_catalog.rs. Root checks: root_validation.rs. Matcher: matcher.rs.
- Protected lists: core/src/cleanup/rules/protected_paths.rs:1-80 (home credential dirs, Library user state, File Provider/CloudKit subtrees). Personal-dir refusal: platform/src/macos/mod.rs:330-358.
- Specialized cleaners (where TOML is not enough): core/src/cleanup/cleaners/{xcode_storage,ai_model_storage,docker_build_cache,conda_cache,rust_toolchains,dropbox_cache,user_cache_inventory,project_artifacts}.rs.
- Project-artifact authored-content guard (nested .git, *-keypair.json, `git ls-files` must show no tracked files): core/src/cleanup/cleaners/project_artifact_protection.rs:58.
- Incident lesson, issue #44: Chrome "offline cache" contained Service Worker/ScriptCache, and deleting it broke Manifest V3 extensions. Browser cache rules need per-browser exclusions.

SCANNER (macOS)
- platform/src/macos/bulk_directory.rs: getattrlistbulk attrs :182-198 (no FILEID/LINKCOUNT, so hard links are counted per link), 64 KiB buffer :14, O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK open :58-76.
- platform/src/macos/analysis.rs: at most 8 workers :28, coordinator with 40 ms poll :27/:447-477, parent roll-up :754-788, reaper for stuck kernel calls :520-594, dataless skip :698-727, device/mount boundary :691, per-purpose size unit (allocated vs logical) :40-50.
- The analysis result is cut to 80 children: core/src/storage/index/cache.rs:302. In-process LRU of 2 roots: cache.rs:22. FSEvents token (FSEventsGetCurrentEventId) for revalidation: platform/src/macos/change_tracking.rs:287-330.
- Spotlight quick large-file scan (mdutil gate, then mdfind -0): platform/src/macos/mod.rs:470-569.
- Duplicates: core/src/storage/duplicates/ (3x16 KiB samples service.rs:121, BLAKE3 full hash with 4 workers :62-63, sparse-group certification :1928, keep at least one models.rs:74-98). Reclaim uses allocated_bytes, so clones are overstated.

DELETION
- core/src/filesystem/permanent_delete.rs: prepare (identity plus FIFO/socket rejection) :128-190, delete_via_staging :551-730 (rename to <parent>/.mangodisk-delete-<pid>-<n>/target, identity re-check, remove, rollback), staging name :1078-1110, macOS delete workers = 2 :33-34.
- GOTCHA / finding: staging is never reconciled after a crash or Quit, and Quit is not guarded (src-tauri/src/commands/resident.rs:136-138). See the analysis board.
- Analysis delete accepts only a direct child of the current folder (:337-343) and reports the scan-time size as freed (:397).
- Privileged app removal: platform/src/macos/privileged_uninstall.applescript (quoted argv; mv, stat identity, rm -rf, restore) plus privileged_uninstall.rs.

UNINSTALL / LEFTOVERS
- core/src/applications/uninstall/macos.rs: accepted app locations :696-716 (/Applications, ~/Applications, depth <= 1), exact bundle-ID associations in 8 ~/Library places :578-642. Never matched by display name (test :1051).
- Orphans only through containermanagerd metadata: core/src/applications/leftovers/macos.rs:69-275.
- Not covered: LaunchAgents/LaunchDaemons, Group Containers, /Library, pkg receipts, system apps.

UI
- Treemap: src/lib/utils/treemap-layout.ts (squarified, area proportional to bytes, remainder tile below 0.75 %). Render: src/pages/analysis/components/md-analysis-treemap.vue (DOM buttons, one level). Reveal: src-tauri/src/commands/file_manager.rs:10-27 (tauri_plugin_opener).

QUALITY
- 1 701 Rust tests (270 ignored, each with a reason string), 155 vitest files. CI on macOS and Windows: .github/workflows/cross-platform-check.yml.

entries.name: Source: kondo
entries.content:
Source: kondo (tbillington/kondo), MIT, Rust, 2 413 stars. Clone: research/sources/tbillington-kondo @1d351ca. Report: research/reports/sources/tbillington-kondo.md. Task T-0020. Findings F-0033, F-0034, F-0035.

## What to take
- **Dev-junk seed data (MIT):** `kondo-lib/src/lib.rs:9-33` (25 marker constants), `:35-94` (per-kind artifact arrays, 63 entries), `:96-119` (display names). Kind to marker mapping is at `:402-445`, and marker to kind uses `artifact_dirs()` at `:163-195`. Special cases:
  - React Native = package.json plus an `ios` or `android` subdir (`:478-480`).
  - `.csproj`/`.fsproj` resolves to Godot if `project.godot` is present, to Unity if `Assembly-CSharp.csproj` is present, and to .NET otherwise (`:432-443`).
- Import the list as JSON dev rules with `verify` and `tier` fields (F-0035). Keep the MIT notice in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES (T-0003).
- **Do not import:** `*.py` as a project marker (F-0034). `.venv` as preselected (upstream removed it in 1d351ca, but release v0.9 still has it at `lib.rs:76`@v0.9).
- **Review tier, never preselected:** `Saved` (Unreal autosaves), `Build`/`Builds` and `Library` (Unity), `vendor`, `Pods`, `bin`, `build`.
- **Rework branch `discovery-rework` @eab2099 (unmerged, idle since 2025-04), for ideas:**
  - `kondo-lib/src/project.rs:18-50`: Project trait with is_project, is_root_artifact and root_artifacts.
  - `kondo-lib/src/search.rs:40-74`: all kinds per folder, prune artifacts only.
  - `kondo-lib/src/project/node.rs:25-48`: package.json with a non-empty `unity` field means a Unity UPM package, not Node.
  - `kondo-lib/src/project/cmake.rs:1-15`: doc listing 5 ways a CMake build dir is placed. Only `build/` is detectable by name.

## Gotchas (verified on this Mac with the v0.9 release binary, `-n` only)
- `kondo -n ~/Library` offered 47 "projects": the pnpm global virtual store (`~/Library/pnpm/store/v11/links/**/node_modules`, 39 of them), pnpm global installs (`~/Library/pnpm/global/v11/<hash>/node_modules`), app plugin deps, and pipx `site-packages`. The dev scanner must exclude ~/Library and must never find a project below an artifact dir (F-0033).
- The only location exclusion is a leading dot in the name (`lib.rs:357-359`). The `-I` ignore flag filters results but does not prune the walk (`main.rs:169`), despite the help text at `main.rs:29`.
- Freed bytes come from the scan, not a measurement (`main.rs:218-226, 396-397`). Sizes are logical `st_size` (`lib.rs:505-513`). pnpm hard links show 4 MiB per project while freeing 0 B.
- Deletion is `fs::remove_dir_all` (`lib.rs:325`). It is permanent, but it does not follow a top-level symlink and has resisted symlink races since Rust 1.58.1.
- Cargo marks `target/` with `CACHEDIR.TAG` (signature 8a477f597d28d172789f06886806bc55) and NSURLIsExcludedFromBackupKey (rust-lang/cargo@70ce895 `crates/cargo-util/src/paths.rs:796-815, 865`). That is a generic "disposable" signal. Which other tools write it is unverified.
- Mole's purge guard is the model to beat: no git-tracked files, no nested .git, no `*-keypair.json` (tw93/Mole@a7fa8dd `lib/clean/project.sh:506-532`). It also excludes Library from the walk (`:702, 716, 771`).

## Acceptance fixture
- `research/bench/tbillington-kondo/probe.sh <kondo-bin> <scratch>` builds a 7-case synthetic home. The expected macontrol results are in comments on each case. The kondo output is in `results-2026-09-23.txt`.
- Get the binary with `gh release download v0.9 -R tbillington/kondo -p 'kondo-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz'`. No Rust toolchain is needed.

entries.name: Source: Radix
entries.content:
# Source: Radix (colinvkim/Radix), integrator pointers

Clone: research/sources/colinvkim-radix @ 14a76df (2026-09-19). MIT, (c) 2026 Colin Kim, so the notice must be kept. The full report is at research/reports/sources/colinvkim-radix.md (task T-0021). All paths below are under Radix/.

## Take (MIT, copy with notice)
- Enumerator: Services/BulkDirectoryEnumerator.swift. The attribute set is at :447-488, the getattrlistbulk loop at :195-285, the fallback errno set {EINVAL, ENOTSUP, ENOSYS} at :307, the O_NOFOLLOW open at :361, the SF_DATALESS skip at :571 and the clone identity (REALDEVID+CLONEID, REFCNT>1) at :717-733. It is paired with ScanDirectoryDescriptorPool.swift (openat leases) and ScanMetadataLoader.swift (FileIdentity/CloneIdentity :770-790, isDataless :619).
- Worker limits: ScanEngine.swift:780-894 (ScanConcurrencyPolicy). Min 2-4, max 8, active cores/2, halved in Low Power Mode and at serious/critical thermal state. Env overrides RADIX_SCAN_*_WORKERS.
- Dedup: SharedAllocationDeduplicator.swift:11-35 decides what claims shared bytes. SharedAllocationOwnerAccumulator.swift decides who keeps them (smallest path) and resolves hard links before clones.
- Volume boundary and firmlinks: ScanEngine.swift:170-263 (ScanVolumeBoundaryPolicy, APFS container via the diskNsM name) and TrashSafetyPolicy.swift:136-165 (/usr/share/firmlinks parser plus fallback list :51-71).
- Geometry: Services/SunburstGeometry.swift (2° minimum, "Smaller Items" at :195-260) and Services/TreemapGeometry.swift (squarified :259-340, 32x24 hit-test grid :593-680). Both are pure and cancellable.
- Cloud warning: Models/ScanTarget.swift:167-221 (CloudStorageLocation.impact).
- Trash with identity recheck: Services/SystemIntegration.swift:435-490 (lstat dev/ino or fileResourceIdentifier, then FileManager.trashItem).

## Improve / rewrite
- Tree model: Models/FileNodeRecord.swift and Models/FileTreeStore.swift. Keep the arena (parentRawIndices, childSpans, childIndices, UInt32 indices). Drop the per-node id=path String, URL and path-keyed index: 943 B/node measured (F-0041, probe research/bench/colinvkim-radix/node_memory_probe_main.swift).
- Auto-summary: AtomicDirectory*.swift plus thresholds at ScanEngine.swift:767-778 (5,000 files, 4 KiB average, depth 2). The decision samples 100 entries and ignores subdirectories (AtomicDirectorySummaryProbe.swift:57-83), so it hides big items (F-0040, probe autosummary_sample_probe.swift). "Expand Fully" is at Features/FileList/FileBrowserTableView.swift:388-392.
- Incremental rescan: FileSystemEventHistory.swift (FSEventsGetCurrentEventId checkpoint, then FSEventStreamCreateRelativeToDevice with FullHistory replay), IncrementalRescanPlanner.swift (full-scan fallbacks), IncrementalScanService.swift:617-640 (volume targets are never incremental). Nothing persists across launches.
- Trash guard: Models/TrashSafetyPolicy.swift:130-134 matches exact roots only (F-0024 class). Replace it with the F-0024 prefix policy and keep its root sources: mounted volumes, firmlinks, Data twins.
- Discard Pile: ViewModels/TrashFlowController.swift. It is in memory only and resultingItemURL is dropped (SystemIntegration.swift:448-449), so there is no undo; see task T-0026. Its totals use allocatedSize (AppModel.swift:43-60), which is the F-0004 class.

## Gotchas
- There are no cleanup rules at all. Radix is a visualizer only, and the one open issue (#38) asks for cleanup recommendations.
- AppModel.swift is a 3,267-line god object. Port the small controllers, not AppModel.
- Package.swift lists every RadixCore source file by hand, and the target builds with defaultIsolation(MainActor). Copied files are mostly `nonisolated` structs and keep working under our isolation settings.
- `swift test` builds about 91k lines (48k source plus 43k tests). The benchmarks only run when an env var is set (RADIX_BENCH*).
- Neodisk (GPL-3.0) is derived from Radix. Always copy from Radix.
- The FDA probe depends on the OS version (SystemIntegration.swift:573-713). On macOS 27 it uses the TimeMachine plist and the Stocks container. Constants are at :50-52.

entries.name: Source: OpenDisk
entries.content:
# Source: OpenDisk (137137137/OpenDisk)

Durable pointers for whoever integrates or re-checks this source. Full report: research/reports/sources/137137137-opendisk.md (task T-0022). Code: 137137137/OpenDisk@6e3f1f7, cloned to research/sources/137137137-opendisk (gitignored; re-clone with `git clone --depth 1`). MIT, 216 stars, last commit 2026-09-22, macOS 15+, Swift 6 mode, SwiftUI.

## Key files and functions (all under OpenDisk/)
- Services/Scanning/SystemInterop/BulkDirectoryReader.swift `read(directoryAt:allowedDevices:)`: getattrlistbulk parser (RETURNED_ATTRS-gated offsets, record-length bounds checks), `ATTR_DIR_MOUNTSTATUS` -> mount stubs, `st_dev` allowlist via fstat. 256 KB buffer per worker.
- Services/Scanning/TraversalScanner.swift `scan(...)`, `WorkState`: fixed blocking worker pool on a custom .userInitiated concurrent queue, LIFO stack plus semaphore plus pending counter; hard-link dedup by (dev, fileID) at :204-223. Worker counts :35-41 (3-5 subtree, 4-8 volume).
- Services/Scanning/ScanEngine.swift: strategy (searchfs only on `hfs`, :255-259), "/" = one traversal plus sibling volumes grafted in (:437-548), streaming snapshots (:71-155, O(n) CoW per snapshot, backoff 8x assembly time, cap 15 s), process tuning (:92-99), replay time budget (:346-358), cache path (:269-344).
- Services/Scanning/FileTree.swift: struct-of-arrays tree (Node 24 B stride + names), Int32 ids, no paths; `rollUpDirectorySizes`, `merge` (firmlink merge points), `serializedData`/`init?(serializedData:)` ("DMT2", range-validated).
- Services/Scanning/ScanCache.swift: ~/Library/Caches/<bundle>/ScanCache/<fnv1a>.dmscan, header = version, eventID, st_dev, root path; mmap load; atomic temp swap; prune to 8 files / 4 GB.
- Services/Scanning/SystemInterop/FSEventsChangeJournal.swift `changes(since:under:timeout:)`: journal replay to HistoryDone; drop/wrap/rootChanged -> nil; caps of 40k deduped changes and 160k raw events; exactly-once continuation latch.
- Services/Scanning/IncrementalUpdater.swift `apply`: shallow re-list per changed dir, subtree rescan for MustScanSubDirs.
- Services/Scanning/SystemInterop/SearchFS.swift: `@_silgen_name("searchfs")` raw syscall, record layout offsets, EBUSY restarts <= 3. HFS+ only by the author's own measurement.
- Services/Search/SearchIndex.swift: memmem over a NUL-separated, NFC case-folded name blob, parallel chunks, 500-result cap.
- Views/Charts/RingsChartView.swift + RingsChartLayout.swift + Models/ChartItem.swift: two-Canvas sunburst, polar hit-test, depth 5, drops < 0.15% and < 0.03 rad. Baobab-derived design (GPL) and original code (MIT).
- Models/Collector.swift + Views/Components/CollectorBar.swift: disjoint collect set, 50-step undo of collection edits, confirmationDialog, then `FileManager.removeItem` (permanent).
- Services/ProtectedPaths.swift: string blocklist guard. Models/HiddenSpace.swift `CleanableCacheCatalog.locations`: the only "rules", 23 hard-coded cache paths (includes Xcode Archives, ~/.Trash, /Library/Caches).

## Rule-file locations
- None data-driven. Cleanup targets live only in Models/HiddenSpace.swift:31-63 (Swift array). Protection lives in Services/ProtectedPaths.swift:9-46.

## Gotchas (verified here unless marked)
- F-0037: IncrementalUpdater re-adds hard links at full size, and the inflated tree is saved to the cache. Probe: research/bench/137137137-opendisk/run_incremental_probe.sh <fixture-dir>.
- F-0038: removeAllChildren leaves garbage nodes and nothing compacts them (2,225 nodes / 206 live after 10 splices).
- F-0039: ProtectedPaths passes /System/Volumes/Data/Users/<me> (same inode as ~). realpath() does not canonicalize firmlinks; fcntl(F_GETPATH) does (checked with Python).
- FSEvents reports firmlinked paths (/Users/..., /private/...), not /System/Volumes/Data/..., so the "/" splice lookups resolve.
- The full scan equals du/dua on research/bench/fixtures/tree (2,359,623,680 B, 3/3 runs) but drops pathmax/ (8,417,280 B, F-0008). The unreadable count reaches the UI only when the view is empty (DiskAnalysisView.swift:649).
- Clones are counted at full size (F-0004 class): no CLONEID/PRIVATESIZE anywhere.
- DiskAnalyzer shows only the top 100 children below the root (maxVisibleChildren, :20), with no remainder row (F-0016 class).
- The cache is keyed by st_dev and path, not volume UUID (unverified risk).
- The FDA probe reads ~/Library/Containers/com.apple.stocks first. Whether it prompts is unverified.
- README "1 TB in 17 s vs DaisyDisk 37 s" and "rescans 20-28x faster" are the author's figures, unverified.

## Probe files
- research/bench/137137137-opendisk/incremental_probe.swift + run_incremental_probe.sh (F-0037, F-0038, FSEvents path form)
- research/bench/137137137-opendisk/protected_paths_probe.swift (F-0039)
- research/bench/137137137-opendisk/fixture_probe.swift (fixture correctness, 3 runs)
All three compile OpenDisk's own files unmodified with `swiftc -O -swift-version 6 -target arm64-apple-macosx15.0 -parse-as-library`.

entries.name: Source: GrandPerspective
entries.content:
Durable pointers for integrators. Source: GrandPerspective, official SourceForge git (https://git.code.sf.net/p/grandperspectiv/source) @3e0088c (2026-09-14, v3.8.1). Clone: research/sources/sourceforge-net-p-grandperspectiv-source (gitignored, depth 61). Report: research/reports/sources/sourceforge-net-p-grandperspectiv-source.md. Task T-0023.

LICENSE: GPL-2.0-or-later (LICENSE = GPLv2 text, Credits.rtf says "or any later version"). macontrol is not GPL, so this is STUDY ONLY: no code, XIB, help text or .clr palette may be copied. Re-implement ideas from our own description. GitHub copies (patmoore 2011, bezigon 2015) are stale mirrors, so do not cite them. No stars on SF; 310,970 downloads over 12 months (SF stats API).

KEY FILES (ObjC, manual retain/release, AppKit + XIB, 30.8k lines)
- Scan: tree/TreeBuilder.m. fts_open(FTS_PHYSICAL|FTS_XDEV) :838-849; serial loop :341-373; visitItem :692-823; hard links by st_ino set :704-715,829-836; APFS dir nlink ignore :558-568; SF_DATALESS skip :743-750; /System/Volumes/Data path skip :751-757; package check "adaptive" (extension-only, ~30% cost) :214-219,719-733; sizes physical=st_blocks*512 (app default, Info.plist:96-97), logical=st_size (+ .icloud plist) :447-459,779-802.
- Model: tree/FileItem.h (UInt8 flags :9-14), DirectoryItem.m (files and subdirs kept as two separate child trees, linked list then balanced :81-128), CompoundItem.m (binary inner node), TreeBalancer.m:39-122 (Huffman-style merge of the two smallest = layout tree).
- Layout: tree/TreeLayoutBuilder.m:29-82 (split the longer side by size ratio, recursive, stops below 1 pt). Draw: view/TreeDrawerBase.m:97-197 (traverser), view/GradientRectangleDrawer.m (CPU pixel fill, 256-step gradient per palette colour, bitmap sized in POINTS :77-111).
- Refresh: tree/TreeMonitor.m (FSEvents dir-level, 3 s latency, sets DirectoryNeeds{Shallow,Full}Rescan), tree/TreeRefresher.m:82-217 (copy clean, re-list shallow, rescan full; hard-link mismatch shows a warning :64-76).
- Filters (the only "rules"): test/*.m predicates, whitelisted decoder test/FileItemTest.m:18-54; defaults Info.plist:135-357 (GPDefaultFilterTests / GPDefaultFilters). Scan filter prunes, mask hides; tree/TreeFilter.m re-filters in memory.
- Delete/reveal: control/DirectoryViewControl.m. Reveal with package workaround :344-400; delete confirm :403-472; gate :661-681; trashItemAtURL :688-699; prefs gate :899-919. Default "delete nothing" (Info.plist:94-95). appHasDeletePermission hard-coded YES "TODO" (control/PreferencesPanelControl.m:82-85). FDA probe lists ~/Library/Safari (control/StartWindowControl.m:17,395-418).
- Freed-space bookkeeping: tree/TreeContext.m:277-328 (in-place FreedSpace tile), :482-513 (counter; hard links counted on purpose).
- Threads: util/AsynchronousTaskManager.m (one NSThread per manager, 512 KiB default stack, latest input wins, abortable).

GOTCHAS
- `test/` is NOT unit tests. There is no test target or CI at all.
- Build probes against the clone with: clang -Os -fno-objc-arc -fobjc-weak -fmodules -include GrandPerspective_Prefix.pch -I<every src dir> tree/{Item,FileItem,DirectoryItem,PlainFileItem,CompoundItem,TreeBalancer,TreeLayoutBuilder}.m util/{PeekingEnumerator,UniformTypeInventory,UniformType,LogManager}.m + a stub `NSString *FileSizeUnitSystemKey`. Scripts: research/bench/sourceforge-net-p-grandperspectiv-source/run_{layout_depth,tile_visibility}_probe.sh (bash; zsh does not word-split $INC).
- The wide-list recursion (addSubdir linked list) is safe at -Os (tail call). Only nesting depth overflows (3,000 ok / 3,500 SIGBUS on a 512 KiB thread).
- Tracker: SF REST works without auth: https://sourceforge.net/rest/p/grandperspectiv/bugs/search?q=status:open, /bugs/<n> (includes discussion posts).

MEASURED (verified locally, macOS 26.6)
- The GP-classes mirror of ~/projects (622,664 files): 167.6 MB max RSS, about 270 B/file all-in; 22.5 s serial fts, cold-ish.
- Tile visibility at 1168x688: 1x 139,591 files (22.4%, 91.9% of bytes) vs 2x 323,604 (52.0%, 96.0%).
- Trash = rename: same inode and blocks, 0.0 MiB free-space delta.

FINDINGS FILED: F-0042 (trash counted as freed), F-0043 (1x raster on Retina), F-0044 (deep recursion crash, cf. bug #125).
EVIDENCE ONLY (no new finding): F-0004 clones (GP has no clone awareness), F-0009 serial walker, F-0001 opposite FDA failure (#123 false "denied"), F-0037 (GP warns on hard-link mismatch instead of recounting), F-0031 (GP skips /System/Volumes/Data by path).

entries.name: Source: Neodisk
entries.content:
Source: tkslucas/Neodisk. GPL-3.0-or-later, with an MIT notice for the parts derived from Radix. 580 stars. Clone at `research/sources/tkslucas-neodisk` @ b26a08c (2026-09-07). Report: `research/reports/sources/tkslucas-neodisk.md`. Task T-0024. Findings F-0045 and F-0046. It inherits F-0040.

## License and lineage (read this first)
- Radix (colinvkim/Radix, MIT, created 2026-04-02) is the original. Neodisk's initial commit 75ae65e6 (2026-07-07) already credits it in LICENSE:676-704 and in the README.
- Never copy Neodisk code into a non-GPL macontrol. For the engine, sunburst or flat treemap, take the Radix MIT version (T-0021 report). Neodisk-only ideas (duplicates, changes diff, cushion renderer, persisted checkpoint, numeric splice) are **reimplement-from-idea** unless T-0003 picks GPL.
- A GPL source file may be compiled from the gitignored clone for a probe, but it must never be copied into `research/bench/`. `research/bench/tkslucas-neodisk/run_hashcache_probe.sh` copies it into a temp dir at run time.

## Key files (Sources/…)
- Bulk listing: `NeodiskKit/Services/BulkDirectoryReader.swift`
  - `:153-160` sets the per-thread IOPOL "no materialize dataless" policy.
  - `:162-167` does a full-path `open(O_NOFOLLOW)`. There is **no openat** (PATH_MAX behaviour unverified).
  - `:178-199` builds the attribute set, and `:500-535` is the package-extension catalog.
- I/O workers: `Services/DirectoryIOExecutor.swift` (serial GCD workers, one getattrlistbulk buffer each). `Services/ScanConcurrencyPolicy.swift` covers thermal and Low Power derating (`:196-340`) and the same-disk ruling for parallel scans (`:92-131`).
- Traversal: `Services/ScanTraversal.swift` (package summary deferral `:434-437`, `shouldTraverseDirectory` `:1190-1201`) and `ScanEngine.swift` (stream `:435-460`, `bufferingNewest(256)`).
- Sizes and dedup:
  - `Models/FileNodeRecord.swift:8-47`: path String, no URL; `cloudOnlyLogicalSize`; `cloneInfo`.
  - `Services/HardLinkDeduplicator.swift`: `rebalancedStore` at `:66-68` redoes the dedup after splices.
  - `Services/CloneDeduplicator.swift:76-140`: non-first clone members are charged `ATTR_CMNEXT_PRIVATESIZE`.
  - `Services/ClonePrivateSizePrefetcher.swift`.
- Tree store: `Models/TreeStorage.swift` (preorder Int32 arrays), `Models/NodeIDIndex.swift` (16 shards keyed by FNV-1a), `Models/FileTreeStore+NumericSplice.swift` (one-pass splice, with the dictionary path as the oracle).
- Incremental rescans:
  - `Services/IncrementalScanService.swift`, `IncrementalRescanPlanner.swift`, `FileSystemEventHistoryProvider.swift`, `FirmlinkPathTranslator.swift`.
  - `Models/ScanIncrementalModels.swift`: checkpoint `:14-40`, 26 full-scan reasons `:158-185`.
  - The checkpoint is persisted in the snapshot metadata (`Services/ScanSnapshotCodec.swift:52-57`).
- Snapshot cache:
  - `Services/ScanSnapshotCache.swift`: directory `:136-148` = `~/Library/Application Support/Neodisk/ScanCache/`; save `:169-238`; `.prev` rotation for diffs.
  - `Services/ScanSnapshotCodec.swift`: preorder records with names only, ids derived from the parent, LZFSE payload, plain JSON header.
- Changes diff: `Models/ScanChangeList.swift` (rename by (dev, ino) with `linkCount == 1`, grown/shrunk for leaves only), `Models/ScanSizeBaseline.swift`.
- Duplicates: `Services/DuplicateFinder.swift` (4 KB → 256 KB head+tail → full SHA-256; `hashableStamp` at `:470-481` rejects dataless and non-regular files by `stat`; `F_NOCACHE` reads at `:559-590`). `Services/DuplicateHashCache.swift` holds the cross-run digest cache.
- Treemap: `TreemapKit/{TreemapLayout,CushionTreemapRenderer,FlatTreemapRenderer,TreemapViewport}.swift` and `NeodiskUI/Treemap/{TreemapScene,TreemapController,TreemapNSView}.swift`.
- Sunburst keys: `NeodiskUI/Sunburst/SunburstKeyboardNav.swift`. Pinch drill latch: `NeodiskUI/Shared/PinchDrillRecognizer.swift`.
- Package expansion: `NeodiskUI/Model/NeodiskViewModel.swift:672-722` ("Show Package Contents" = rescan with `treatRootPackageAsDirectory`).
- Age buckets: `NeodiskUI/Statistics/AgeStatistics.swift` (mtime only, measured against the scan date).
- Volume space: `NeodiskKit/Services/VolumeSpaceInfo.swift` (used = capacity − importantUsage; hidden = used − scanned).

## Gotchas
- F-0045: a persisted scan equals a copy of everything the FDA scan saw, readable by any same-user app without FDA (verified with `research/bench/tkslucas-neodisk/cache_tcc_probe.sh`). macontrol's cache must be encrypted, or must aggregate protected roots.
- F-0046: the digest cache stamp is size+mtime+inode with no ctime. Before any delete, re-verify by byte compare (`run_hashcache_probe.sh` shows the stale hit).
- F-0040 is inherited byte-for-byte (`NeodiskKit/Services/AtomicSummary/AtomicDirectorySummaryProbe.swift:58-85`).
- Hidden space: the code comment says purgeable space is included, but the math excludes it. Scanned purgeable files lower the hidden figure (not measured; 1.83 GB purgeable here).
- `SECURITY.md:26` says "no network requests", but Sparkle (neodisk.app/appcast.xml) and CloudScan both make network requests.
- There is no CI. Issue #9 (31.5 GB RAM) is fixed only on unreleased `main`.
- Dev hooks worth copying: `NEODISK_HEADLESS`, `NEODISK_SCAN_TIMING` felt-time marks, `--render-png`, `NEODISK_SNAPSHOT_DIR` (`AGENTS.md` "Dev hooks").

entries.name: Source: WinDirStat
entries.content:
Source: windirstat/windirstat @ da13ad6 (GPL-2.0, study only; 4,106 stars; C++23 Win32/ATL). Clone: research/sources/windirstat-windirstat (gitignored). Report: research/reports/sources/windirstat-windirstat.md. Probes and output: research/bench/windirstat-windirstat/ (palette_probe.py, hardlink_attribution_probe.py, dedupe_probe.sh, results.txt).

## Key files and functions (all paths under windirstat/)
- Treemap renderer: Controls/TreeMap.cpp. DrawTreeMap 659-871 (stack loop, AddVisibleItem, BuildHitTestIndex). DrawCushion 1006-1069 (per-pixel Lambert). AddRidge 1071-1087 (van Wijk surface). SetOptions 436-451 (light vector, lz=10). Presets 268-307. Defaults and palette: Controls/TreeMap.h:337-374.
- Layouts: Controls/TreeMapLayout.cpp (ArrangeRows = KDirStat, MinProportion 0.4, 33-101; ArrangeSquarified 103-182; dispatcher and invariants 185-210). Hilbert/Moore: Controls/HilbertMooreTreeMap.cpp. Its templates come from varg-dev/hilbert-moore-treemap-layouts-prototype (MIT); port from THAT, not from this GPL file.
- Hit test: TreeMap.cpp:493-620 (16 px grid, only the parent's exclusive area is indexed), FindItemByPoint 873-904.
- Cached bitmap + overlays: Views/GraphView.cpp:103-161. Nothing is drawn until root->IsDone() (85-89).
- Legend colours: WinDirStatModel.cpp:436-497 (rank by logical bytes -> colors[min(rank,17)]). Extension highlight: Views/TreeMapView.cpp:98-115. Folder-branch palette (close to Okabe-Ito): TreeMap.cpp:99-166.
- Scanner: Item.cpp:1093-1202 ScanItems. ScanBatch (128 children / 100 ms flush) Item.cpp:25-97. BlockingQueue.h (LIFO, idle-exit, CancelSynchronousIo). Thread start: WinDirStatModel.Actions.cpp:1151-1213. FinderBasic.cpp (NtQueryDirectoryFile, 4 MiB buffer, size corrections 184-245).
- Hard links: Item.Extended.cpp:746-955 (synthetic <Hardlinks> node), Item.cpp:386-389. The pass is rebuilt on every refresh (WinDirStatModel.Actions.cpp:1063-1072, 1245-1253).
- Delete: WinDirStatModel.cpp:499-659 (parallel DeleteFileForce from the scan-time tree, then IFileOperation). DeleteFileForce: HelpersTasks.cpp:246-276.
- Command enablement table: WinDirStatModel.Actions.cpp:37-179.
- Empty-folder removal (a good pattern: attribute re-check + non-recursive RemoveDirectory): WinDirStatModel.Actions.cpp:1483-1570.
- Duplicates: Controls/FileDupeControl.cpp:52-120 (size -> XXH3-64 over 4 KiB / 1 MiB / full). Hardlink dedupe: WinDirStatModel.Actions.cpp:1401-1436, HelpersTasks.cpp:688-704.
- User-defined cleanups: Options.h:99-120 (record), WinDirStatModel.cpp:791-842 (cmd.exe /C template substitution).
- Settings defaults: Options.h:180-354 (ScanningThreads 4, ProcessHardlinks true, ExcludeSymbolicLinksFile true, ShowUnknown/ShowFreeSpace false).
- Tests: tests/Test-WinDirStat.ps1 (black-box E2E, PowerShell ground truth, multi-spelling enumeration parity). No unit tests. CI does not run tests.

## Rule-file locations
- There are no cleanup target rules. Cleanup is select + delete, hard-coded Windows maintenance commands (WinDirStatModel.Actions.cpp:314-350, 633-723), or user shell templates stored in settings (registry / portable INI).

## Gotchas
- The license headers say "GPL v2 or later" but the README says v2 only. Irrelevant to us: study only.
- Legend rank uses LOGICAL bytes, while the map uses PHYSICAL bytes by default.
- IFileOperation trash uses FOF_NOCONFIRMATION without FOF_WANTNUKEWARNING: per the docs, silent destroy when an item cannot be recycled (docs + code read, not run).
- The treemap is CPU-rendered on the UI thread. The parallel row path only runs for leaves of 512k+ pixels.
- The per-entry queue mutex is polled 3 times per directory entry (Item.cpp:1143, 1179-1180). Use an atomic flag in macontrol.
- A shallow clone has no history: use `gh api repos/windirstat/windirstat/commits/<sha>` for provenance (for example 860d840 fixed the dedupe group merge on 2026-09-05).

## Board
- Task T-0025. Findings F-0047 (hard-link attribution; LCA rule), F-0048 (dedupe via hard link; use clonefile + verify), F-0049 (file-type palette CVD; colour by kind).
- Class evidence posted as comments: T-0014 (F-0024 guard class), T-0015 (F-0018 silent trash-to-permanent class).

entries.name: Source: QDirStat
entries.content:
# Source: QDirStat (shundhammer/qdirstat), integrator pointers

Clone: research/sources/shundhammer-qdirstat @ 88a577f (2026-09-20). Report: research/reports/sources/shundhammer-qdirstat.md. Task T-0027. Findings: F-0050, F-0051, F-0052, F-0053.

## License
GPL-2.0-only (metainfo and spec files say `-only`). **Study only.** No code, .ui file, icon or default table may be copied. Re-implement the treemap from the papers: squarified (Bruls, Huizing, van Wijk 2000) and cushion (van Wijk and van de Wetering 1999).

## Key files (src/)
- Scan:
  - `DirReadJob.cpp:214-381` `LocalDirReadJob::startReading`: access, opendir, readdir into `QMultiMap<ino_t,QString>`, then one `fstatat` per entry in inode order.
  - `:395-441` `processSubDir`: exclude rules, the macOS `/System/Volumes/Data` string skip, mount crossing.
  - `:733-880` `DirReadJobQueue`: a BFS FIFO driven by a 0 ms QTimer on the GUI thread, one whole directory per tick.
- Size model:
  - `FileInfo.cpp:72-156`: st_size, st_blocks*512, sparse when allocated + 2048 < size.
  - `:248-267`: size()/allocatedSize() divide by nlink for regular files.
  - `FileInfo.h:959-979` has the member layout (the maintainer says sizeof = 128 B, #219).
- Aggregation: `DirInfo.cpp:577-651` updates totals incrementally up the ancestor chain in childAdded. `:241-318` is the lazy `recalc` after deletes. `:985-1063` caches sorted children per column.
- Treemap:
  - `TreemapTile.cpp:191-283` squarify.
  - `:286-379` layoutRow (plus cushion ridges).
  - `:469-528` renderCushion (per-pixel CPU).
  - `:840+` CushionSurface.
  - `TreemapView.cpp:304-390` is the synchronous rebuild. `:570-651` is the selection sync (findTile does a linear scan of scene items).
- Categories: `MimeCategorizer.cpp:90-165` (suffix hash, multi-dot fallback, then wildcard patterns) and `:336+` (defaults, incl. Junk = `*~`, `*.bak`, `core`).
- Exclude rules: `ExcludeRules.cpp:25-120` (name or full path; wildcard, regexp or fixed) and `:216-226` (a rule matching "dir contains file X").
- File age stats: `FileAgeStats.cpp:65-230`, doc/File-Age-Stats.md. Histograms and percentiles: `FileSizeStats*.cpp`, `HistogramView.cpp`, doc/stats/*.md.
- Cache file: `DirTreeCache.cpp` (gzip text, `[qdirstat 2.0 cache file]`), doc/cache-file-format.txt, scripts/qdirstat-cache-writer (Perl, for servers).

## Rule and config locations
- Cleanup actions: defaults in `StdCleanup.cpp:18-38`, user copies in `~/.config/QDirStat/QDirStat-cleanup.conf`, read at `CleanupCollection.cpp:499-592`.
- MIME categories: `QDirStat-mime.conf`. Exclude rules: `QDirStat-exclude.conf`. Section classes: `Settings.h:28,138,169,200`.
- There are no cleanup targets and no leftover heuristics. It is a visualizer with user shell actions.

## Gotchas (do not port)
- **Placeholder expansion is multi-pass** (`Cleanup.cpp:176-196`). A `%d`/`%n` inside a substituted path re-expands and breaks the quoting (F-0051). The probe is `research/bench/shundhammer-qdirstat/expand_probe.py` and its output `expand_probe.out`. Reuse it as an oracle for any template feature.
- **Delete runs on the raw, unnormalized selection** (`CleanupCollection.cpp:295-308`). The scan root is auto-selected after every scan (`MainWindow.cpp:595,495,808-809`). The confirmation shows 7 items in QSet hash order (F-0050). The maintainer rejects changes (#267, #293, #316).
- **Refresh after delete re-reads the parent** (the whole tree when that is the scan root: `DirTree.cpp:220-224`) and disables actions until it finishes (F-0052). The opt-in `AssumeDeleted` is the splice idea we want as the default.
- **Trash is XDG** (`~/.local/share/Trash`, `.Trash-$UID`), even in the macOS build, which I checked with strings on 2.0-macos.2 (F-0053).
- `SIMULATE_COMMAND` is defined but unused (`Cleanup.cpp:23`): there is no dry run.
- There are no threads anywhere. A directory with a million entries blocks the UI for the whole read.
- Hard links are divided by nlink, not deduplicated. That undercounts when some links are outside the tree (compare F-0010). Clones are never read (compare F-0004).
- PATH_MAX: a too-long path fails `access()` and is labelled DirPermissionDenied (`DirReadJob.cpp:225-230`). The label is wrong, but at least it is not silent.

## Board classes this source also shows (evidence comment on T-0027)
- F-0004 (clones)
- F-0008 (PATH_MAX, surfaced)
- F-0009 (serial walker)
- F-0010 (nlink split)
- F-0012 (permanent rm -rf)
- F-0026 (hierarchical selection)
- F-0031 (firmlink string skip)

## macOS build
`jesusha123/qdirstat-macos` (131 stars, GPL-2.0) builds upstream at `cb014eb` with no source patches (build.yml only appends to src.pro). Team ID XKURB6WHH2, not sandboxed.

entries.name: Source: dua-cli (dua-core)
entries.content:
Pointers for whoever ports or benchmarks dua-core. Source: Byron/dua-cli@cf59618 (MIT, (c) 2019 Sebastian Thiel). The clone is at research/sources/Byron-dua-cli. The report is research/reports/sources/byron-dua-cli.md, and the task is T-0029 (child of T-0006).

## Key files and functions
- Scheduler: crates/dua-lib/src/lib.rs
  - start_pool :784 (Worker::new_lifo per thread, Injector, Parker, sync_channel(threads*2))
  - worker_loop :903 (idle flag, park, wake one more worker after a successful steal)
  - find_job :947 (injector, then local LIFO, then steal)
  - run_job :972
  - read_dir_native :1134 (macOS/Windows; the bulk probe and reopen live at :1150-1168)
  - schedule_stat_entries :1241 (at most 64 queued jobs, then runs inline)
  - publish_directory :1399 (ParentFirst sends the batch before its child jobs; Completion does the reverse)
  - finish_pending / finish_root :1443-1459
  - Drop for Pool :927 (stop, disconnect, join)
  - Walk::next_cancellable :526 (polls every 100 ms)
- Public API: walk :435, walk_roots :602, walk_root_entries :630, stream_roots :381 (roots added while the walk runs), read_dir :425. Constants: ENTRY_CHUNK_SIZE = 4 (:137), MAX_QUEUED_STAT_JOBS = 64 (:140).
- macOS reader: crates/dua-lib/src/macos/mod.rs
  - ReadDir::open :325 (opens the full path, which is the PATH_MAX weakness in F-0008)
  - refill :351, which calls getattrlistbulk with FSOPT_PACK_INVAL_ATTRS and adds FSOPT_ATTR_CMN_EXTENDED when clone data is requested. Fallbacks: EACCES switches to list-only attributes; EINVAL/ENOTSUP drops the APFS attributes; an unsupported filesystem falls back to fs::read_dir.
  - next_record :447 (directories and firmlinks get a path lstat)
  - probe_metadata_with_cpu_time :279 (CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID compared with wall time; two waiting refills switch the directory to readdir plus parallel lstat)
  - clone_attributes_at :563 (getattrlist for roots and for entries that were stat'd)
- Attribute parser: crates/dua-lib/src/macos/attributes.rs
  - attribute sets :29-56 (FTS set, LIST_ONLY set, APFS set)
  - parse_record :172 (bounds-checked Cursor :403)
  - satisfies_fts_stat_contract :384
  - fts_allocated_bytes :372 (rounds up to 512 B)
  - data_fork :154 (the EF_MAY_SHARE_BLOCKS gate)
- Hard links and clones: src/inodefilter.rs
  - add_dev_inode :149 (countdown map)
  - add_directory :102 (UNRESOLVED marker, because the bulk directory link count omits . and ..)
  - apfs::allocated_size :177 and add_clone :196
- Tree: src/traverse.rs
  - TreeNode :142 (64 B)
  - Tree :234 (names arena, u32 links, free list)
  - integrate_traversal_event :1274 (the ancestor walk is at :1488)
  - BackgroundTraversal::start_inner :1043 (channel bounded(100) :1053; a fresh InodeFilter at :1137 is the refresh double-count bug)
  - clean vetting: CleanCandidate::forward_entry :1559, walk_clean_candidates :1628 (32 slots)
  - macOS size_on_disk :1848
- Totals only: src/aggregate.rs aggregate_inner :268 (Order::Completion; the comment at :332 says "first root that reaches them wins")
- Options: src/options.rs (DEFAULT_THREADS = 8 on macOS :66, dedup flag :157, -x :162); src/main.rs:718 (cross_filesystems defaults to true)

## Rule-file locations (clean)
- The rules are hard-coded in src/clean.rs:17-35: .mypy_cache .pytest_cache .ruff_cache .tox .venv .zig-cache __pycache__ node_modules target venv zig-cache zig-out.
- Content gates at src/clean.rs:150-161: target needs a Cargo.toml next to it; venv and .venv need pyvenv.cfg.
- Git gate, src/clean/git.rs:15-58: inside a repository a candidate must be ignored as Expendable and hold no tracked paths. It fails closed and honours precious patterns (gitoxide.parsePrecious).
- There is no data file. macontrol should carry these as data.

## Delete flow
- Keys: Ctrl+r deletes permanently "without prompt", Ctrl+t trashes (src/config.rs:574-575). Issue #248, asking for a safer key, was declined.
- src/interactive/app/deletion.rs:137-225 walks the target again with skip_metadata, then runs fs::remove_file per path in parallel and removes directories deepest-first.
- There is no dev/ino identity check, no journal and no privilege escalation.
- Trash uses trash-rs 5.2.5 (Finder osascript, one call per path, quotes escaped).

## Gotchas (verified)
- F-0054: shared hard links and clones are charged to the first folder the parallel walk reaches, which changes run to run (17/13 of 30). Do not port "first seen"; use the LCA rule (F-0047).
- The TUI 'r' refresh makes a new InodeFilter, so shared inodes are counted again: 8.7 MB became 17.1 MB (F-0037 class, T-0022).
- --deduplicate-apfs-clones handles full clones only. The fixture's 119 MiB partial clone is still counted twice (T-0009).
- -A includes directory st_size (+10.7 MB on the fixture, the same as ncdu).
- Paths longer than PATH_MAX are skipped when scanning and cannot be deleted (F-0008).
- The TUI does need a tty, but it can be driven headless: research/bench/byron-dua-cli/pty_once.py runs `dua i --once=<keys>` under a pty that answers ESC[6n and renders the screen with pyte.
- The 2.45.0 engine and clean code were agent-written and "rubber-stamped" (CHANGELOG.md:23-27, 170-174). Trust the tests more than the prose.
- On APFS, macOS resolves byron-dua-cli and Byron-dua-cli to the same clone directory.

entries.name: Source: DaisyDisk
entries.content:
Durable pointers for integrators. DaisyDisk is **closed source**, so there is no code to take. Everything below is public material plus bundle metadata. Full report: `research/reports/sources/daisydisk.md` (T-0028). Findings: F-0055 (root helper outlives the app), F-0056 (snapshot purge through the file Collector).

## Where the evidence lives (gitignored, re-fetchable)
- `research/sources/daisydisk/guide4/<Page>.txt`: text snapshots of all 31 v4 guide pages (https://daisydiskapp.com/guide/4/en/<Page>/). Report citations `G:<Page>:<line>` point into these.
- `research/sources/daisydisk/site_releases.txt`: the full release log 1.5.3 → 4.34.2 (`R:<line>`). `site_specs.txt`, `site_support_faq.txt`, `site_support_pricing.txt`, `home.txt`, `site_blog.txt`, and `blog/*.txt` (12 posts).
- `research/sources/daisydisk/bundle-metadata.txt`: plutil, codesign and launchctl-plist dump of `DaisyDisk.zip` 4.34.2 (sha256 45ef4639…4257). The app was never launched or disassembled.
- `research/sources/daisydisk/homebrew-cask-daisydisk.rb`, `brew-abstract_uninstall-216-260.rb`, `appcast.xml`.
- Screenshots worth opening: https://daisydiskapp.com/img/home/intro-ss1.png (main report layout), `/img/guide/4/en/dd_c_full.png|dd_c_system.png|dd_c_purging.png` (Collector states), `dd_hidden2.png|dd_purgeable.png` (hidden-space rows), `dd_fda.png` (FDA tab), `dd_overview.png` (disk list).

## Interaction spec to copy (the benchmark)
- **Sunburst:** folders are coloured by top-level branch, files are grey, width is proportional to size, and siblings are sorted by size. Items too thin to see merge into one semi-transparent "smaller objects" petal, which Return expands; the expanded state is remembered per folder. Hover shows the folder's children in the sidebar, click drills down, click the centre goes up. A path bar with back and forward sits on top (G:UnderstandingSunburst:6-13, R:61-62).
- **Collector:** drag, ⌘⌫ or context menu adds an item. The bar shows a ring gauge "N GB collected" and a red Delete. It expands into a list with Quick Look and a × per item. A protected item is refused at drop time with a named reason (G:DeletingFiles:6-15).
- **Keyboard map** (G:Hotkeys:9-55): ↑↓, PgUp/PgDn, Home/End, ⌘↑ parent, ⌘[ ⌘] history, Return drill, Space Quick Look, ⌘⌫ to/from Collector, ⌘-click reveal in Finder, ⌘R / ⇧⌘R rescan, ⌥ toggles purgeable in the gauge. Pinch gestures work too.
- **Hidden-space breakdown:** used − scanned = hidden, split into purgeable, other volumes, snapshots (for reference, not additive) and still hidden. Footer rows "free space" and "~ free + purgeable" (S:45, G:HiddenSpace:6-23, G:Snapshots:18).
- **Disk list:** gauge that counts purgeable as free (⌥ shows the truth), starred folders, live free-space updates, a per-device scan queue for HDDs (G:DisksOverview, G:ParallelScan).

## Gotchas
- DaisyDisk deletes **permanently** after a 5-second countdown (G:DeletingFiles:16-17). Do not copy that. Use the Trash or quarantine plus a journal (F-0012) and "Empty these from Trash" (F-0042).
- Snapshot and purgeable purge go through the same Collector as files. Keep them out of the file tray (F-0056). `tmutil thinlocalsnapshots / <bytes> <urgency>` is the gentle primitive (`man tmutil`).
- Clone and hard-link policy is "first occurrence counts, the rest 0 B", so folder sizes depend on traversal order (the class of F-0054). Clone detection needs macOS 14+ (their 4.34 broke older systems; 4.34.1 fixed it). Partial clones are never accounted for (G:HardLinks:18-20).
- On Sonoma, reading `~/Library/Containers` and `Group Containers` stalls because of per-access privacy checks. DaisyDisk's escape hatch is ⌥-click Scan, which skips both (blog 4.26.1). Re-test on macOS 26 before designing around it.
- DaisyDisk's helper label is `com.daisydiskapp.DaisyDiskStandAlone.AdminHelper` (SMJobBless, `AssociatedBundleIdentifiers` set). The Homebrew cask names `com.daisydiskapp.DaisyDiskAdminHelper`, which is **wrong** (Casks/d/daisydisk.rb:20-21). Uninstall and leftover logic must derive helper labels from the bundle (F-0055). The launchd key `AssociatedBundleIdentifiers` is a reliable ownership signal.
- This Mac has orphaned root helpers `com.docker.socket` and `com.docker.vmnetd` in /Library/PrivilegedHelperTools, with no plist and no app. Use them as a live test case for an orphan-helper scan.
- The updater is a private Sparkle 1.15.0 fork (AJet/Sparkle @aa179f95) with DSA-only appcast signatures. It is not a model; macontrol uses Sparkle 2 + EdDSA.
- Vendor open source: AJet/DFeedback (MIT, a feedback and crash window). Nothing else is reusable.
- The "DaisyDisk" name is a registered trademark. Use the pattern, not the look, name or wording.

## Open (needs launching the app, which is a user decision)
Scan syscalls and memory per node, whether the Collector persists across relaunch, whether purge has an extra confirm, the full protected-path list, and how purge is implemented.

entries.content:
# Source: dumac (healeycodes/dumac @ 1ffbe3c)

**License: none. Ideas only. Never copy code, not even the parser.** Report: research/reports/sources/healeycodes-dumac.md. Task: T-0030. Finding: F-0060.

## Where things are (src/main.rs, 353 lines, the whole program)
- `main` :108-141. Builds the rayon pool: `min(available_parallelism, 224)` threads (:118-122) with 16 MiB stacks (:123-128).
- `calculate_size` :144-186. Sums the files serially, recurses into subfolders with `into_par_iter`, and turns an `Err` into 0 (:173-179).
- `get_dir_info` :188-353. `open(fullpath, O_RDONLY)` :190-201; attribute list :204-216; `[0u8; 128*1024]` stack buffer :218; bulk loop :222-345; `close` :347-350 (skipped on the error return at :241).
- Parse order :247-343. RETURNED_ATTRS, then NAME, then ERROR, then OBJTYPE, then FILEID, then ALLOCSIZE. **Wrong:** ERROR belongs right after RETURNED_ATTRS (man getattrlistbulk lines 85-86).
- Hard-link set :36-61. 128 `parking_lot::Mutex<HashSet<u64>>` shards chosen by `(inode >> 8) % 128`. The key is the inode only, and every file goes into the set.
- Sizes: ALLOCSIZE rounded to 512-byte blocks (:64-66, :316-325); symlink fixed at 1 block (:332-335); folders and other types count 0.

## Verified numbers (research/bench/healeycodes-dumac/results.txt, hyperfine JSON)
- Fixture: 670 ms (dua 722, diskus 1,325, du 6,582, serial bulkwalk 6,204). Total 2,360,152,064 B, the same in 3 of 3 runs = du + 1,032 symlinks × 512 B; pathmax/ dropped. RSS 42.9 MB (dua 11.2).
- ~/projects: 2.34 s and 59.2 MB, against dua's 2.63 s and 17.9 MB.
- 127 nested folders cause SIGABRT (stack overflow) with no output; 126 work. The stack costs about 128 KiB of RSS per nesting level.
- `ulimit -n 8` gives totals of 30 MB to 660 MB against 2,360 MB, exit 0. 61 `r--` folders leak 61 fds; at `ulimit -n 64` that zeroes 79 % of the tree.
- Two fresh APFS images mounted side by side: dumac reports half of du's total, because inodes 16.. collide.

## Gotchas for an integrator
- The fast path (parallel bulk, one folder per task, work stealing) is worth copying as an idea. The error, fd and stack handling is not.
- An inode number alone is not unique once the walk crosses a mount. `(st_dev, st_ino)` is unique, including across the System and Data volume group: System inodes sit at 2^60 + n, for example /bin/ls = 1152921500312571391.
- A per-entry ATTR_CMN_ERROR is real: an entry with only RETURNED_ATTRS|NAME|ERROR (0xa0000001) can be provoked by racing /dev/fd (research/bench/healeycodes-dumac/cmn_error_probe.c).
- A GUI app starts with 256 fds (launchd). An unprivileged `setrlimit` raises that to 10,240 or more (verified).
- Rust on this Mac: no system cargo. A minimal rustup in the scratchpad (RUSTUP_HOME/CARGO_HOME, `--no-modify-path`) takes about 450 MB, and dumac builds in 7.5 s.

entries.name: Source: parallel-disk-usage (pdu)
entries.content:
Source: KSXGitHub/parallel-disk-usage (pdu), Apache-2.0, 732 stars, Rust. Clone at research/sources/KSXGitHub-parallel-disk-usage @ c30e46f (the path is case-insensitive, so the lower-case slug is the same dir). Report: research/reports/sources/ksxgithub-parallel-disk-usage.md. Task T-0031. Findings F-0057, F-0058, F-0059. Repro: research/bench/ksxgithub-parallel-disk-usage/repro.sh [unreadable|order|alias|quadratic].

## Key files (all @c30e46f)
- Walk: src/tree_builder.rs:41-70 (recursive rayon into_par_iter per dir; nodes below max_depth are summed and dropped at :64-69). src/fs_tree_builder.rs:62-172 (read_dir names only :157, full-path symlink_metadata :105, join :167, error branches :105-116 and :133-145, device boundary :84-97 and :120-121).
- Sizes: src/get_size.rs (apparent = st_size, block = st_blocks*512, count = st_blocks). The Unix default is block size (src/args/quantity.rs:24). A dir counts its own inode size (src/data_tree/constructors.rs:7-14).
- Node: src/data_tree.rs:25-29 {name OsString, size, children Vec}. Measured about 77 B/node on the fixture (full tree 30.7 MB footprint vs 6.6 MB at -d 1).
- Hard links: record in src/hardlink/aware.rs:60-92 and hardlink_list.rs:52-175 (DashMap keyed (ino, dev) -> {size, nlink, paths}). Dedup pass in src/data_tree/hardlink.rs:16-44 (strip_prefix filter per child, subtracts size*(links_in_subtree-1)). Summary in hardlink_list/summary.rs:83-95 (panics if paths > nlink).
- Pipeline order: src/app/sub.rs:131-138 (cull, then sort, then dedup: the F-0059 bug). JSON export :148-193.
- Progress: src/reporter/progress_and_error_reporter.rs:39-107 (atomic counters plus a 100 ms sampler thread); interval set in src/app.rs:279-283.
- Threads and HDD cap: src/app.rs:186-204, src/app/hdd.rs (a no-op on macOS per :135-139; use IOKit kIOPropertyMediumTypeKey, SDK IOStorageDeviceCharacteristics.h:606/634/662).
- Root overlap: src/app/overlapping_arguments.rs:54-107 (realpath prefix; misses firmlinks, which causes F-0058).
- Tests: tests/hardlinks_deduplication.rs has 6 scenarios worth porting. It re-sorts by name (:60) and always uses --min-ratio=0, which is how F-0059 slipped through. tests/cli_errors.rs:120-190 never checks the exit code.
- Benchmark model for T-0004: .github/workflows/deploy.yaml:497-700, ci/github-actions/benchmark/matrix.ts (48-category self matrix plus competing matrix), check-for-performance-regressions.ts (10% gate vs the last release), ci/make-tree-with-hardlinks.sh (only 20 inodes). Linux only, and totals are never checked.

## Gotchas
- Default mode double-counts hard links (F-0010). The bench's `pdu-H` line is the comparable one.
- Unreadable or TCC-denied folders read 0 B with exit 0 (F-0057). pdu -s hides even the stderr line.
- `pdu -H X /System/Volumes/Data/X` exits 101 and prints no JSON (F-0058). Build temp paths with `pwd -P`: mktemp gives /var/..., whose /System/Volumes/Data alias does not exist, only /private/var/... has one.
- The -H dedup pass is quadratic per wide folder (0.14 -> 7.89 s user for 1k -> 8k same-folder pairs), but negligible on ~/projects (62 inodes). Not filed. It is skipped entirely at -d 1, so the bench (-d 1) never exercises it.
- At -d 1 pdu keeps no tree, so its bench RSS (14 MB) says nothing about an app that keeps the tree.
- PATH_MAX caps pdu's recursion on macOS (511 levels scanned fine). An fd-relative walker loses that cap and needs an explicit queue (F-0044 class).
- In zsh, `cmd 2>&1 >/dev/null` does not discard stdout (MULTIOS). Time commands under `bash -c` instead.
- The Homebrew pdu is arm64. The GitHub release ships only x86_64-apple-darwin.
